name: swisseo-browser-vendor
description: Pins the runtime libraries of swisseo-browser.html and generates ../../lib/ (node vendor.mjs). The versions here are the single source of truth; Dependabot watches this manifest. After a bump: npm ci && node vendor.mjs, then update the lib/ file names in the LIB_CDN map of swisseo-browser.html and in the README SBOM table.
